description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530175 (24/0742)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent measurements, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
